name: report
summary: The orchestration domain. Stores a report configuration (data source + query Spec + template + slot mapping + formats) and owns Runner, the single end-to-end pipeline every produced report goes through: compile the Spec against the stored schema, run it read-only, project the template's Doc, render the files. Also serves the preview and download HTTP endpoints.
exposes: Runner.Document(ctx, rep) (template.Doc, error) — query + template half, shared by every format
Runner.Render(ctx, rep) ([]render.Artifact, error) — for email delivery / scheduling (not yet built)
Runner.RenderFormat(ctx, rep, format) (render.Artifact, error) — for the download endpoint
Runner.prepare(...) (unexported) — the ONLY place a query is compiled in this package; handlers call it directly for previews
Report struct (QuerySpec query.Spec, Query string, TemplateID, TemplateConfig, Formats []render.Format)
HTTP: GET /api/report-templates, POST /api/reports/preview, POST /api/reports/preview-template, GET+POST /api/reports, GET /api/reports/{id}/download?format=, DELETE /api/reports/{id}
key_notes: Runner is the ONLY path that produces a report. Preview, download, and the future scheduled/email delivery all go through it, which is what makes 'what you preview is what recipients get' true. Do not add a second rendering path.

reports.query stores the compiled SQL as READ-ONLY documentation for the user. It is never executed and never accepted back from a client; query_spec is the source of truth and is recompiled on every run so relative date windows stay relative.
A report saved before the query-spec change has an empty spec; Spec.IsZero() makes Runner.Document return ErrNotRunnable (HTTP 409) telling the user to rebuild it.

POST /api/reports does NOT run the query — it validates the template config against the template's slots only (queryColumns=nil) and compiles the spec (which also proves the data source belongs to the caller). Rendering re-validates the mapping against the columns actually returned.
There is no update/PUT endpoint for a report. Editing means delete + create.

Formats: a create request that OMITS `formats` defaults to [pdf]; one that sends an empty array is rejected. A DB CHECK (cardinality(formats) >= 1) backs this up, and scanReport re-parses stored names through render.ParseFormats so an unknown format fails loudly rather than silently delivering fewer files.
Download without ?format= returns rep.Formats[0]. RenderFormat refuses a format the report isn't configured for.

Error mapping lives in handlers.go helpers — writeQueryError / writeTemplateError / writeRenderError / writeResolveError. ErrQueryFailed maps to 502 (the query is ours, so a failure is the source's end); ErrInvalidSpec to 400.

queryTimeout = 30s bounds every run. Preview limits rows via previewLimit() (min of spec limit and datasource.PreviewRowLimit=50); a full run uses runLimit() and passes the connector the same cap the spec asked for.
Failures inside Runner are log.Printf'd as well as returned, because scheduled runs are unattended.
selectReports INNER JOINs data_sources for the source name — safe because the FK cascades on delete, so a report always has its source.
